data.name: Grasp of Honesty
data.description: Any creature you are grappling or pinning is affected by zone of truth (Will DC %1 negates). Outside of combat, you may use this ability by touching a target with both hands. You can use this ability %2 rounds per day. These rounds do not need to be consecutive. The effect ends if you stop grappling, pinning, or touching the target.|GraspOfHonestyDC|GraspOfHonestyRounds
